description: The verifier contract's nominal fixtures hard-code the pre-Phase-2 green commit and assert only process status. At the required review commit the fresh command produces 10/12 with the valid gates and controlled-gates cases failing because currentPhase is 3, contradicting the stored 12/12 ledger and making CRIT-005 non-reproducible from the authoritative review snapshot.

evidence.snippet: test(`${helper}: accepts one valid explicit input`, () => { const r = run(helper, valid); assert.equal(r.status, 0); ... });
